data.body:
Patchset 4: cost figure corrected from a point estimate to a measured range.

The rebased tree's `make verify` came in at 26m04s (19261 passed, 63 skipped, EXIT=0) against
the 22m25s I had documented from the pre-rebase run. Same host, same PYTEST_WORKERS=4; the
spread is host load. A single '~22 min' understates the real cost by about 18%, and this
ticket exists because documentation that overstates what a local command guarantees gets
believed. Quoting the faster of two measurements would have been the same mistake in
miniature, so all three sites now say 20-25 minutes, name BOTH measurements, and tell the
reader to plan for the top of the range.

That also settles the coordinator's question about whether the rebase needed a full re-verify:
it did, and it changed a documented number. The conflict was Makefile/.PHONY text only, but
main had moved eight commits, so measuring beat assuming.

Full-suite green on the rebased tree also confirms the diagnosis in bug
newborn-ethnologic-scaup: test_mechanism_delta's narrow-selection ModuleNotFoundError does not
appear in a whole-tree run, which is exactly why CI never saw it.

Post-edit gates: make lint EXIT=0, make typecheck EXIT=0, and 44 passed across
test_check_docs_index + test_predates_gate_guard_parity + test_api_surface_gate.
